description: Search the notes synced from the user's Obsidian vault, by keyword and by meaning, and get back where each one lives in the vault with an excerpt around the match. Use this when they ask what their notes say about something, or point at their vault ('in my notes', 'from my Obsidian'). Narrow with vault_id, folder (a vault path prefix like 'Meetings/2026'), or tag. Returns object_id and path for follow-up with get_obsidian_note, which returns the full note.

folder.description: Only notes under this vault folder, e.g. 'Projects'.

query.description: What to look for in the notes.

tag.description: Only notes carrying this tag, e.g. 'meeting'.

name: search_obsidian_notes
title: Search vault
